title: Event-driven dispatcher cadence: research-queue-chain.yml re-arms the dispatch from its own completion (GitHub cron + keeper cadence were bounded by pushes to main)
note: [2026-10-21 PIPELINE-HEALTH-1021] ROOT CAUSE (Actions API, 2026-10-21): research-queue-dispatch's hourly cron created runs 04:56/10:14/15:18Z (3-5 h apart); schedule-keeper's own '7 * * * *' floor fired 10:04/12:27/15:12/17:40Z; the rest were keeper runs on push-to-main. A quiet main (10:42->12:14Z, 94 min, zero keeper runs) left the dispatcher idle with 20-70 units runnable = the 75-135 min gaps the watchdog self-healed 10-19 and 10-21 and the 3.5 h dispatcher_age_h breach. github_runner is 3 fires/cycle so each missed cycle starves the low-value themes (regime). FIX: .github/workflows/research-queue-chain.yml (workflow_run on dispatch completion -> wait to created+60 min -> gh workflow run unless a newer run exists). Cron + keeper unchanged as fallbacks. NOT observed yet: merged != deployed != observed.

observation.what: after merge, research-queue-dispatch runs are created <= 70 min apart across a window with no push to main, and watchdog `dispatcher` incidents stay 0 for 48 h
observation.how_to_check: gh run list --workflow research-queue-dispatch.yml --limit 30 --json createdAt,event; comms/research/ops/watchdog_incidents.jsonl; research-slo dispatcher_age_h
